### Praying the Names of God - January 19
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-january-30.html
Passage: John 1:29
Points:
- While lambs represent gentle innocence today, to John's listeners they evoked the altar of animal sacrifice.
- The sacrificial system provided a way to approach God while illustrating the costly penalty of sin.
- Calling Jesus the Lamb of God signaled that He would voluntarily give His life as an offering for humanity's debt.
- Believers can look to Christ as the ultimate sacrifice who bore their guilt and opened the way to God.

### How to Live the Bible — Christ Takes Away Our Sin
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2022/03/how-to-live-the-bible-christ-takes-away-our-sin/
Passage: John 1:29-34
Points:
- John the Baptist encountered Jesus and received divine revelation that He was the promised Savior.
- Jesus fulfills the purpose toward which all Old Testament sacrifices pointed.
- God does not merely offer partial pardon, but completely removes human sin and guilt.
- Like a sacrificial lamb, Jesus carried the transgressions of the world upon Himself.
